name: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks
description: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks (SST) enhances Jellyfin playback with in-player subtitle search, download, and temporary timing controls. Phase 1 provides a "Find subtitles" entry in the CC/subtitle menu during playback. Requires a configured subtitle provider (e.g., Open Subtitles).
overview: In-player subtitle search and timing controls for Jellyfin Web and supported clients.

versions.changelog: Phase 1 POC: reliable web script loading; "Find subtitles" injected into the Jellyfin 10.11.x subtitle action sheet; stub dialog; removed crash-prone injection code; improved FileTransformation bundle hooks.
